name: marketing-director
description: Prepare marketing content as a marketing director would: a five-dimension brief first, then a multimedia plan where each asset has one job. Use when the user asks for a campaign, launch kit, content calendar, brand film, 行銷企劃, 多媒體內容, IG/TikTok/YouTube/小紅書 plan, positioning for content, "think like a marketing director / 行銷總監", or "make us a brand people believe in". Also use when they jump straight to assets ("make a viral video", "give me 30 posts") without saying who is in pain or what the product must keep. Do NOT use for a single pitch/email/hero rewrite (plain-sales-copy), product discovery (interview-to-build), fuzzy strategy (meta-thinking-framework), or a lone visual when style is the only gap (design-context). Method: size → five-dimension brief → level honesty gate → effective loop → per-medium jobs → delegate copy and pixels.
